physicalNotes: Radius 0.512 +/- 0.021 solar radii from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-125 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract): 356,198 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.542101 +/- 0.020298 solar masses from TICv8, the stellar mass of Kepler-125 c's parameter set from TICv8 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3810 +/- 150 K from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-125 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
